integrity: Analytical proof and independent numerical/symbolic program were checked in the same review; no independent mathematical audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic, two-dimensional real SPD linear systems, fixed positive common relaxation, and round-synchronous two-coordinate commits.
Only three deterministic directed one-round message-age patterns are classified; arbitrary schedules, larger matrices and wall-clock speed are not treated.
The augmented three-state delayed-message matrix appears in older literature; the claim is solely the stated sharp comparative parameter theorem.
title: A sharp nine-eighths relaxation-window gain from one delayed Jacobi message
